description: This file contains a set of unit tests using Xunit for validating the behavior of the BRD Asset Configuration feature. It tests validation rules such as date ordering, required fields, and missing dependencies for different API endpoints related to data asset management.

classes.name: BrdValidationGapsTests
classes.description: A test class containing regression tests focused on validation rules in the BRD Asset Configuration domain within the DataAssetBackend project.

methods.name: Create_status_log_rejects_end_date_before_start_date_400
methods.description: Tests that creating a status log with an end date before the start date results in a 400 BadRequest response indicating validation failure.

methods.name: Create_data_input_value_rejects_blank_period_400
methods.description: Tests that submitting a blank reporting period field leads to a validation error with a 400 BadRequest response.

methods.name: Create_parent_input_mapping_requires_parent_input_id_400
methods.description: Validates that omitting the parent input ID in a parent-input mapping request results in a 400 BadRequest.

methods.name: Create_ef_source_mapping_requires_reporting_program_400
methods.description: Ensures that missing the reporting program ID in an EF source mapping request results in a 400 BadRequest.
